# Dataset Archiver for WebDAV


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

## Why this exists

Many researchers work with datasets that must be archived **immutably**
but are not suitable for open repositories (e.g. Zenodo, OSF) due to:

- Size or institutional restrictions
- Non-public or sensitive data
- Reproducibility requirements across projects

This tool: - Ensures data + metadata are stored together - Prevents
accidental overwriting - Tracks every upload with a versioned folder -
Embeds clear usage restrictions (non-commercial, permission-required)

## Features

- ✅ Uploads entire folders to WebDAV
- ✅ Appends a date + hash to create unique, immutable archive folders
- ✅ Automatically generates:
  - `metadata.json`
  - `manifest.csv` (file list)
  - `LICENSE.txt` (non-commercial, permission-based)
  - `README.txt` (human-readable)
- ✅ Skips or warns on conflicts
- ✅ Supports dry runs
- ✅ CLI or notebook use

## Usage example

``` python
from dataset_archiver.core import upload_dataset_to_webdav

upload_dataset_to_webdav(
    source_folder="/path/to/my_dataset",
    base_webdav_url="https://u-drive.unipi.it/remote.php/webdav/RRL/archival_data",
    label="2025_exp01",
    metadata={
        "title": "Underwater anomaly scan",
        "source": "Collected in Portoferraio",
        "date_collected": "2025-07-24",
        "description": "Raw magnetometer + IMU logs with sonar overlay",
        "responsible": "Andrea Munafo"
    },
    username="a012197",
    contact_email="andrea.name@unipi.it"
)

Requires a valid WebDAV login (password securely prompted).

## Project structure

This repo uses [nbdev](https://nbdev.fast.ai) to manage:

- 🧪 Tests in `test_*.ipynb`
- 📦 Code in `core.ipynb`
- 📁 `data/test_dataset/` for reproducible testing

### Install dataset_archiver in Development mode

```sh
# make sure dataset_archiver package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to dataset_archiver
$ nbdev_prepare
```

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/Robotics-Research-Lab/dataset-archiver):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/Robotics-Research-Lab/dataset-archiver.git
```

or from
[conda](https://anaconda.org/Robotics-Research-Lab/dataset-archiver)

``` sh
$ conda install -c Robotics-Research-Lab dataset_archiver
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/dataset-archiver/)

``` sh
$ pip install dataset_archiver
```
